files.AGENTS.md:
# Fixture repository guidance

Review only. Do not change files, comments, PR state, or finding records. Confirm behavior through src/api.js and the public contract tests. Treat test runs as local evidence, not a GitHub mutation.
files.docs/contract.md:
# Item listing contract

GET /items delegates to getItems. The query limit is an integer from 1 through 100. At most limit entries are returned. Archived entries are excluded unless includeArchived=true. Sort uses case-insensitive ASCII names; IDs break ties. Fixture inputs use ASCII names and unique IDs. No external database or service exists.
